name: Rooftop Rally
tagline: Parry the orb at your rivals on a city rooftop. Last one standing wins.
summary: Everyone plays Yamato. Block the orb when it comes for you and aim it at someone else. It gets faster with every return.
description: A free-for-all on a rooftop above the city, with Archmother and the Hidden King looking on. A Celeste orb chases one player at a time, and only that player can send it back. Block with left click or your parry key, and your aim picks the next target. Weapons and Yamato's own abilities are off. A hit knocks you out until the next round, and so does falling off the roof. Before the first round, pick one special for the match: Power Slash makes your next return 50% faster, Blink teleports you up to 12 m, and Time Freeze stops the orb for 0.6 seconds while it's coming for you.

howToPlay.title: Block the orb
howToPlay.body: When the orb turns on you, block with left click or your parry key. Only its target can send it back.

howToPlay.title: Aim your return
howToPlay.body: Your aim picks the next target. The orb curves toward them and gets faster with every return.

howToPlay.title: Last one standing
howToPlay.body: A hit knocks you out until the next round. The last player left wins, and the next round starts five seconds later.

legend.label: Its target, the only one who can block it

facts.label: Specials
facts.value: Power Slash, Blink or Time Freeze

whatsNew: First release: free-for-all for up to 8 players.
Three specials: Power Slash, Blink and Time Freeze.
Knocked out? Watch the players still in until the next round.
A rally meter counts the returns in each exchange and heats up as it grows.
